photographers.title: Henri Cartier-Bresson：几何街头
photographers.subtitle: 决定性瞬间 / 几何构图
photographers.summary: 强调线条、人物位置和街头瞬间，适合有行人、楼梯、窗框、影子和空间关系的照片。
photographers.risk: 如果画面没有人物或几何关系，会显得只是普通黑白。

prompt.positive: Geometric street documentary edit, decisive-moment composition, natural available light, balanced black-and-white tones, subtle grain, preserve candid realism.
prompt.negative: staged scene, fake people, heavy vignette, surreal contrast, changed architecture
prompt.preserve: 保留原始人物、街景、几何线条和构图。

photographers.title: Daido Moriyama：粗粝黑白
photographers.subtitle: 高反差 / 颗粒 / 街头能量
photographers.summary: 把街头照片推向粗粝、高反差和强颗粒，适合夜街、反射、运动和不完美构图。
photographers.risk: 对风景和干净人像会过重，细节可能被压暗。

prompt.positive: High-contrast grainy black-and-white street edit, raw urban energy, deep blacks, bright highlights, rough documentary texture, preserve original scene.
prompt.negative: smooth beauty retouch, clean commercial look, color pop, fake objects
prompt.preserve: 保留原始街景结构和主体，不新增人物。

photographers.title: Fan Ho：光影几何
photographers.subtitle: 城市诗意 / 剪影 / 负空间
photographers.summary: 强调强光、阴影、建筑线条和孤独感，适合有明显光影层次的城市或建筑照片。
photographers.risk: 如果原图光线很平，会缺少成立条件。

prompt.positive: Poetic urban light-and-shadow edit, strong geometric composition, elegant black-and-white tones, small human figure, atmospheric depth, realistic texture.
prompt.negative: flat lighting, fake sun rays, overprocessed HDR, invented silhouettes
prompt.preserve: 保留原始建筑、人物位置和透视。

photographers.title: Saul Leiter：层次色彩街头
photographers.subtitle: 雨窗 / 反射 / 色块
photographers.summary: 适合玻璃、雨天、反射和遮挡，用柔和对比和红黄蓝色块制造安静层次。
photographers.risk: 普通晴天大风景不太适合，可能缺少层次。

prompt.positive: Layered atmospheric color street edit, soft reflections, muted painterly color, gentle contrast, quiet urban mood, preserve candid realism.
prompt.negative: neon cyberpunk, hard HDR, fake rain, oversharpened details
prompt.preserve: 保留真实反射、遮挡、人物和街景关系。

photographers.title: William Eggleston：日常强色彩
photographers.subtitle: 普通物件 / 民主视角
photographers.summary: 把日常场景里的颜色和细节认真对待，适合路牌、车辆、街角、室内物件和生活记录。
photographers.risk: 不适合想要梦幻或大片感的照片。

prompt.positive: Everyday color documentary edit, vivid but believable local color, direct composition, ordinary details treated with visual importance, realistic texture.
prompt.negative: cinematic grade, glamour retouch, surreal saturation, removed ordinary details
prompt.preserve: 保留日常物件和真实环境细节。

photographers.title: Stephen Shore：冷静彩色纪实
photographers.subtitle: 真实 / 平衡 / 城市观察
photographers.summary: 适合城市、建筑、道路和旅行记录，调色克制，强调真实空间关系和准确透视。
photographers.risk: 不会特别炸眼，优势是自然和耐看。

prompt.positive: Calm color documentary edit, accurate perspective, natural daylight, quiet geometry, restrained saturation, realistic travel observation.
prompt.negative: dramatic cinematic grade, heavy vignette, fantasy color, aggressive grain
prompt.preserve: 保留原始场景、建筑关系和透视。

photographers.title: Joel Meyerowitz：暖色街头
photographers.subtitle: 自然光 / 人与环境
photographers.summary: 适合暖光街头、海边、城市公共空间，保留环境中的人物关系和明亮空气感。
photographers.risk: 如果原图过暗或没有人物环境关系，效果会弱。

prompt.positive: Warm color street documentary edit, luminous natural light, readable shadows, human figures in environmental context, realistic color.
prompt.negative: overly dark grade, fake sunset, isolated portrait crop, oversaturation
prompt.preserve: 保留环境范围和人物位置。

photographers.title: Ernst Haas：色彩运动
photographers.subtitle: 运动 / 抽象 / 光影碎片
photographers.summary: 适合有运动模糊、反射、灯光和色彩碎片的照片，把模糊变成设计感。
photographers.risk: 不适合需要清晰主体的纪念照。

prompt.positive: Expressive color motion edit, painterly photographic blur, vivid light shapes, abstract urban energy, preserve original scene structure.
prompt.negative: fully sharp commercial look, fake light trails, new subjects
prompt.preserve: 保留原始运动方向和场景结构。

photographers.title: Gordon Parks：人文纪实肖像
photographers.subtitle: 人物尊严 / 环境叙事
photographers.summary: 适合环境人像和纪实人物，强调表情、环境背景和自然尊严感。
photographers.risk: 不适合过度美颜或时尚大片诉求。

prompt.positive: Humanist documentary portrait edit, expressive face, meaningful environment, natural light, dignified tonal structure, realistic texture.
prompt.negative: beauty filter, theatrical glamour, plastic skin, removed background context
prompt.preserve: 保留人物身份、表情和环境背景。

photographers.title: Vivian Maier：街头肖像
photographers.subtitle: 自然光 / 凝视 / 方构图
photographers.summary: 适合街头人物、倒影和日常手势，画面直接、安静、带观察感。
photographers.risk: 如果没有人物或明确动作，会缺少核心。

prompt.positive: Candid street portrait edit, natural available light, quiet observational mood, clean subject gesture, subtle black-and-white or restrained color.
prompt.negative: posed fashion retouch, fake expressions, heavy skin smoothing
prompt.preserve: 保留人物身份、姿态和街头环境。

photographers.title: Slim Aarons：阳光度假色彩
photographers.subtitle: 泳池 / 旅行 / 明亮生活方式
photographers.summary: 适合泳池、度假、阳光旅行和社交场景，画面明亮、轻松、整洁。
photographers.risk: 不适合阴暗街头或粗粝纪实。

prompt.positive: Sunlit leisure color edit, clean bright palette, relaxed social atmosphere, polished travel-lifestyle feeling, realistic skin and sky.
prompt.negative: gritty grain, dark noir, fake luxury props, overexposed skin
prompt.preserve: 保留真实人物、天空和环境。

photographers.title: Rinko Kawauchi：安静明亮细节
photographers.subtitle: 高调 / 柔和 / 日常细部
photographers.summary: 适合花、水、玻璃、小孩、生活细节和柔和光线，强调安静、明亮、细腻。
photographers.risk: 不适合强烈夜景或需要硬朗对比的照片。

prompt.positive: Luminous quiet detail edit, soft high-key light, gentle pastel color, delicate everyday subject, subtle contrast, realistic photographic texture.
prompt.negative: harsh contrast, dark cinematic grade, heavy clarity, neon color
prompt.preserve: 保留原始细节主体和柔和光线。

photographers.title: Alex Webb：层次饱和街头
photographers.subtitle: 强光影 / 多平面 / 彩色复杂性
photographers.summary: 适合复杂街头、强阳光、多层前后景和浓郁色彩，让画面更有街头密度。
photographers.risk: 简单风景或单主体照片会显得过度。

prompt.positive: Layered saturated street color edit, strong sun and shadow, multiple planes of action, rich disciplined color, realistic documentary detail.
prompt.negative: flat single-subject look, fake crowd, muddy saturation, fantasy color
prompt.preserve: 保留原始人物、街景和层次关系。

photographers.title: Gregory Crewdson：环境电影感
photographers.subtitle: 冷暖灯光 / 静止叙事
photographers.summary: 适合空街、室内、郊区夜景和有故事感的空间，强调安静张力和控制光线。
photographers.risk: 会比普通修复更风格化，不适合真实旅行记录。

prompt.positive: Cinematic environmental photo edit, cool ambient shadows, warm practical lights, quiet narrative tension, polished realistic lighting, preserve original scene.
prompt.negative: fake set pieces, added characters, surreal props, excessive teal-orange
prompt.preserve: 保留原始环境、人物和光源位置。

photographers.title: Nan Goldin：亲密闪光日记
photographers.subtitle: 室内 / 直闪 / 真实关系
photographers.summary: 适合室内朋友、聚会和私人纪实感照片，保留直接闪光和不完美真实感。
photographers.risk: 不适合需要精致商业质感的照片。

prompt.positive: Intimate flash-diary documentary edit, direct indoor light, saturated but realistic color, candid personal mood, preserve natural imperfections.
prompt.negative: glamour retouch, plastic skin, fake party props, over-cleaned background
prompt.preserve: 保留人物身份、真实光线和现场关系。

photographers.title: Peter Lindbergh：克制黑白人像

photographers.summary: 适合自然人像、窗光和有表情的脸，保留皮肤质感和克制黑白层次。
photographers.risk: 不适合想要强美颜或彩色情绪的照片。

prompt.positive: Restrained black-and-white natural portrait edit, soft directional light, real skin texture, honest expression, subtle tonal contrast.
prompt.negative: beauty smoothing, plastic skin, fashion glamour excess, fake studio light
prompt.preserve: 保留人物身份、真实表情和皮肤质感。

photographers.title: Annie Leibovitz：环境编辑人像

photographers.summary: 适合摆拍和环境人像，用受控光线和背景关系增强人物存在感。

prompt.preserve: 保留人物身份、姿态和环境。

photographers.summary: 适合旅行人像、市集和有地方色彩的场景，突出眼神、织物和背景色彩。

prompt.positive: Dense travel color portrait edit, expressive eyes, rich natural colors, controlled highlights, strong sense of place, realistic skin tone.
